manifest.notes: Ethereum mainnet UNLOCK/UNLK launch; technical manifest, not deployment evidence. Source: https://github.com/identity-md-launches/launch-2064-unlock-symbol-unlk-review-adapt-and-depl at b957a835f1cca9eef51a121851e2026fc17ff435; accepted work retained. Recorded supported import and prepared launch.open validation passed; active-job source/history binding still needs platform reconciliation. Recorded payment and launch evidence matches payer/setup authority/treasury 0x48e4e74fe1d0c14404ceb57b9fec5b21329c6ec9. Prior chain-1 reproduction: beforeInitialize (0xdc98354e) raised InvalidConfig() (0x35be3ac8), inside WrappedError with HookCallFailed context; factory identity was the first failing service check. The accepted repair moves service attestation from beforeInitialize to authenticated deployPriceSource; deployCompanions and configureAndActivate retain full enforcement. Initialization/seed need no companions. Swaps, credit synchronization and gates stay disabled until activation; ordinary transfers and eligible native claims remain independent. Four constructor words; ten permissions (0x3fcc). PoolManager-only callbacks; constructor-bound factory alone initializes the exact sorted UNLK/IMD key once at fee12500/spacing60. Factory deploys token/hook/native distributor and locks seed principal. Fixed 1B supply, 18 decimals, minted once to factory; 10% swarm/87% pool/3% payer with documented seed rounding. Nominal initialPrice is 1:1; actual opening derives from policy's 2500 IMD whole-supply cap and token ordering. LP fee 1.25%, collections split 80% payer/20% IMD (nominal 1%/0.25%). Fixed extra 75bps on executed IMD accrues as IMD claims to the named treasury. At zero core protocol fee, ignoring impact/rounding, effective buy/sell totals are about 1.98511166%/1.990625%; core protocol fees may increase totals without halting swaps/gates. Manual IMD NFT purchases only; no automatic purchases, listings or burns. UnlkImdOracle combines official UNLK/IMD spot with stateless ImdSpotUsdSource (verified IMD/ETH spot x validated Chainlink ETH/USD) and fixed 1B supply for USD FDV. Chain/code, key, decimals, liquidity and feed-freshness checks remain. No sample(), keeper, history or warm-up. Invalid references after activation prevent new gates only; trading and existing rights continue. Quota=max(0,floor(matureE*p/10000)-S); standard Universal Router initiator accounting, cumulative acquisitions/sales and one-block buy maturity. Transfers create no quota rights. Verified allocation/claim credits remain deduplicated. 1000 acquired,200 sold at20%,then30% permits100 more. Initial20%; USD FDV gates100K:25%,250K:30%,500K:35%,1M:40%,2M:45%,3.5M:50%,5M:55%,7.5M:60%,10M:65%,15M:70%,20M:75%,25M:80%,30M:85%,35M:90%,40M:95%;50M permanently bypasses quotas for EVERY holder, including transfer-only recipients. A valid touch observed after swap or checkpoint permanently opens the highest crossed gate; no delay/relocking. Accepted risks: shared-executor quota pooling and manipulation of either pool, including same-transaction external-reference manipulation, can permanently unlock early; these remain disclosed/tested. Stage1 leaves trading inactive. Before broadcast, obtain actual release identities/native round0 tree, re-mine final initcode salt/flags and rehearse owner-signed setup. Owner deploys price source/companions, certifies tree, then atomically activates with valid price and seals setup. No upgrades, pauses, rule changes, resets or exemptions. Supplied unmodified Hook/Token checks passed locally; Owners check lacks platform helpers and is covered separately, not claimed passed. Official admission/panel, source reconciliation/publication/attestation and release inputs remain platform operations. No mainnet deployment/activation is claimed. Full evidence and responsibilities: docs/admission-fix/REPORT.md and STATUS.json; price/economic details: docs/mainnet/SPOT_PRICE.md.
